apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Each rep's notch is now painted as it happens: dull at the start of the push, full orange through the hold, fading as you lower — so finished reps show the history of each one.
The rep you're on now changes color with effort: it brightens to full orange as you push, stays full on hold, and fades back as you lower.
Lowering is now a clear beat followed by soft beats that slow down and fade — the mirror of the push.
